items.name: NVIDIA Green
items.role: the brand. Every primary CTA, every active state, every link affordance on dark surfaces, every corner square, and the brand wordmark itself.

items.name: NVIDIA Green Dark
items.role: pressed state for the primary button — a single notch deeper than the brand green.

items.name: Accent Green Pale
items.role: rare highlight tint used in editorial callouts and decorative micro-blocks; never on chrome.

items.name: Page Canvas
items.role: the body of every page. Cards sit directly on it with hairline rules.

items.name: Soft Surface
items.role: breadcrumb strip, sub-nav, side-by-side comparison panels, alternating row backgrounds.

items.name: Black Canvas
items.role: hero chapter, dark CTA strips, footer, primary nav. The system's "frame" color.

items.name: Surface Elevated
items.role: nested dark panels inside the footer (column dividers, fine-print bar).

items.name: Hairline
items.role: 1px card border, table rule, divider between footer link sections.

items.name: Hairline Strong
items.role: 1px divider on dark surfaces (footer column rules, dark-mode card edges).

items.name: Ink
items.role: headlines and body text on .

items.name: Body
items.role: long-form paragraph text where pure black is too heavy.

items.name: Mute
items.role: metadata, breadcrumb separators, footer copyright.

items.name: Stone
items.role: least-emphasis text and disabled state.

items.name: Ash
items.role: disabled icon color and faint utility text.

items.name: On Dark
items.role: primary text on .

items.name: On Dark Mute
items.role: ): secondary footer link text and dark-canvas body copy.

items.name: Error
items.role: validation messages, destructive confirmation.

items.name: Error Deep
items.role: pressed state for error buttons; hover-pressed validation icons.

items.name: Warning
items.role: caution callouts, deprecated documentation banners.

items.name: Warning Bright
items.role: inverse warning on dark canvas.

items.name: Success Deep
items.role: positive confirmation where NVIDIA Green's saturation would clash.

items.name: Link Blue
items.role: inline anchor link color on light canvas — the only blue in the system, reserved for prose-embedded hyperlinks.

items.name: Accent Purple
items.role: research / scientific computing editorial accent.

items.name: Accent Purple Deep
items.role: paired dark for purple lockups.

items.name: Accent Purple Pale
items.role: wash background for editorial callouts.

items.name: Accent Yellow Pale
items.role: documentation tip / soft callout fill.
